entry_points.text: Idle entry asserts interrupts then sleeps clock; exit runs disabled, stops accounting, restarts stopped tick. Interrupt entry wakes clock and refreshes jiffies when stopped; exit sleeps in idle or refreshes full tick, with empty variant and broadcast check; misuse warns.

Second reads return epoch seconds with optional store; sets enforce permission and apply wall time. Microsecond/timezone validate ranges and gates, convert and delegate. Tuning copies struct, delegates, copies back with 32-bit translation; faults fail.

Early init reads persistent wall and boot offset, validates, derives wall-to-mono offset, enables default source, installs internals and publishes full update under lock. Per-keeper setup inits lock and sequence, assigns identity and validity.

exports.text: Deactivation marks idle, publishes ordered wakeup, clears ignore unless indefinite; activation clears idle, ignores local event, resets indefinite wakeup, walks upward under lock with fallback. Base try/clear manage idle markers without base lock on clear; non-SMP keeps min.

Lock-free query passes hint through when unsupported, else indefinite unless migrator-owned and lonely through ancestors, otherwise folds hint with ancestor expiries. Ownership is caller mask or none, solitude at most one; idle use warns.

Stop marks base idle, clamps late deadlines, retains on busy base, hands off jiffies duty, parks indefinite and arms pinned high-res or low-res event with checks. Full-dynticks stop-or-restart and retain variants build on it; low-res parks deadline then reprograms on restart.

Sleep estimate starts from device deadline, refuses advance when stop disallowed, else folds next tick event with earliest high-res deadline excluding scheduler timer. Raw deadline and attempt counter exposed.

Tick/time conversions saturate: msecs/usecs cap with negative msecs unbounded, timespecs clamp and round up, tick split uses one division, legacy truncate and safe add saturate, user clocks return all-ones on overflow with rate-selected scaling.
Calendar maps epoch seconds to date via Thursday-anchored March computation and back with Gregorian leap rules; cycle accumulators add masked deltas with fractional carry from caller start.

Readers serve mono, boot, tai, real, raw, coarse and seconds without guards; fast latch paths add offsets to fast mono, guarded paths combine base plus deltas, raw uses unadjusted base, real seconds also atomic, resolution reports ns per cycle.

Snapshot captures cycles, ids and times under retry, invalid when suspended or unknown, raw sharing mono. Realtime-to-base and crosststamp convert via cycles with callback in retry, interpolating outside interval. Base needs matching id or nonzero factors; scaled helpers signal overflow, interval handles wraparound.

Aux exposes resolution, timespec, set and adjust; set validates and publishes offset from mono, enable seeds from core raw and marks valid, timespec maps success to zero. Boot is real minus boot offset; multigrain realtime clamps to shared floor with compare-exchange advance.
Paravirtual register/unregister run under exclusive timekeeper guard with interrupts saved, refreshing exported time on registration; paired helpers offer that acquisition and restore.

hazards.text: Readers warn while suspended; early clock freezes at suspend snapshot. Entropy fallback returns zero when suspended or clockless, else unprotected direct read.

invariants.text: Idle stop refused without nohz, with reschedule, surviving softirq unless hotplug-safe or realtime-blocked, and on full dynticks holding duty or missing timekeeper. Pending sets emit bounded rate-limited warning.

Source replacement preserves time while recomputing intervals, rescaling carry, resetting error and recording tick length plus correction. Sampling prefers hardware snapshot; isolated atomic holds mono floor.
Leap counts quadrennial except centuries unless quadricentennial; February base plus leap, Apr Jun Sep Nov thirty days, rest thirty-one. Advance steps day, month, year with yearday reset.
Active aux set is a bitmask read once per refresh.
Persistent and suspend flags drive RTC skip decisions; sleep injection clears need flag under core lock before notifying timers.
Each stop evaluation bumps attempt counter; positive-deadline stops also bump sleep counter and record deadline. Got-idle-tick is consuming; restart stops accounting when leaving stopped state.

locks.text: Mutation holds core raw guard with interrupts saved; steady readers retry under sequence, fast readers around latch bases.

Source change checks module outside lock, then under core guard forwards shadow, swaps internals and publishes before aux refresh and release. Aux refresh skips invalid under per-aux guards; pulse on core, enable nests aux in core, disable starts with aux.

state_machines.text: Entry sets in-idle and idle-active with timestamp; exit clears and wakes clock. Stop records state then sets stopped; restart clears and rearms. Sleep and wakeup bracket parking; misuse warns once.
Advancement separates tick mode consuming cycles from frequency-change mode reprogramming rate without tick accounting.
Aux starts invalid at setup, valid on enable, skipped while invalid, reinstalled from core raw on change.

structs.text: Per-CPU tick holds flags, stall, timer deadlines, entry time, expiry and idle counters, dependency mask and clock check. Device pairs event pointer with periodic or oneshot mode. Flag bits zero to five are in-idle, stopped, idle-active, do-timer-last, nohz, highres; guard and old-time gate defined.

Primary state pairs sequence guard with active/shadow keepers plus raw guard per index with core alias. Fast latch duplicates bases from suspend-aware full-mask unity descriptor on separate lines. Snapshot cell and dummy clock cover suspend and early use.
Update uses bit zero clear-discipline and bit one stepped with combined mask; hour is sixty times sixty seconds, day twenty-four hours.
Adjtimex result groups audit data with timespec delta and set flag. Syscore connects suspend and resume callbacks via ops and syscore objects registered at init.
